development_notes: Initial complete seven-module run: 300 tested, 231 caught, 60 unviable, 6 timeouts, 3 survived. Survivors exposed missing cumulative-refusal counters and the accepted side of CLI MiB conversion boundaries.

The complete admission/main rerun resolved both counter survivors. A CLI conversion survivor remained because both tested file sizes were refused by a smaller wrong budget; added exactly-at-limit and just-over-limit inputs.

Final complete main rerun: 22 tested, 20 caught, 2 unviable, no survivors. Aggregate uses only unchanged engine/cache/host/model/query from the broad run, admission from its complete rerun and main from the final complete rerun. No duplicate scopes.
limits: Six timeouts break bootstrap/worker/recovery progress; separate from assertion catches. Unviable substitutions are compiler/build failures.
Grammar/dependency internals, serialization/hash macro bodies, optional probe orchestration and Python driver are outside these native mutation scopes.
Browser execution is checked separately; DOM painting/CSS and application rendering are outside source-description mutation testing.
